steps.summary: On the RD-1016 detail I clicked "Edit" on the Part A row ("fwrd86-n2 RD Part A"), which opened the Edit part dialog pre-filled with Cost 100 / Markup 25 / Qty 1. I changed Cost to 150 (leaving Markup 25% and Qty 1 untouched) and clicked "Save part". The dialog closed and the Parts table refreshed: Part A now shows Cost $150.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1 and an app-computed Price of exactly $187.50; Part B is unchanged at $250.00, and the "Total (price × quantity)" line is now $437.50 (previously $375.00).

Clicking "Mark Ready" on RD-1016 was first blocked by an alert reading: "Ticket is not ready — Part \"fwrd86-n2 RD Part A\" has no supplier; Part \"fwrd86-n2 RD Part B\" has no supplier". So the enforced precondition is that every part must have a supplier (note: the Add/Edit part dialog labels Supplier as "Optional"). I satisfied it by opening the Edit part dialog for each part and setting Supplier = "fwrd86-n2 Supplier Co" on both Part A and Part B, saving each. Clicking "Mark Ready" then succeeded with no alert: the status badge now reads "Ready" and the action buttons changed from "Mark Ready" to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed". Parts and total were unaffected ($187.50 + $250.00 = $437.50).
